card.title: Quantum numbers — the address of every electron

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Rutherford found the nucleus but his orbiting electrons should radiate and crash; Bohr quantised angular momentum (mvr = nh/2π) and explained hydrogen's lines, but failed beyond it. The quantum model replaces orbits with probability orbitals: four quantum numbers (n, l, mₗ, mₛ) address each electron, filled by Aufbau (lowest energy first), Pauli (one address per electron) and Hund (singly before pairing, parallel spins).

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: Bohr: mvr = nh/2π · Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV (H)  ·  de Broglie λ = h/mv  ·  Δx·Δp ≥ h/4π  ·  n: 1..∞ · l: 0..n−1 (s,p,d,f) · mₗ: −l..+l · mₛ: ±½  ·  filling: 1s 2s 2p 3s 3p 4s 3d 4p…

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Bohr works for single-electron species only (H, He⁺, Li²⁺). Quantum numbers obey their ranges strictly (l < n; |mₗ| ≤ l). Aufbau ordering holds to Z = 30 for this syllabus — with the famous Cr/Cu exceptions safely beyond it. Heisenberg limits joint precision, never single measurements.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Sodium's valence electron (Z = 11, …3s¹): n = 3, l = 0, mₗ = 0, mₛ = +½ (NEB 2024). The set n = 3, l = 1, mₗ = +2 is IMPOSSIBLE (|mₗ| > l) — the NEB 2023 validity question. s orbitals are spheres, p orbitals dumbbells along x/y/z.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: Na (Z = 11): configuration 1s²2s²2p⁶3s¹ → valence electron n = 3 (third shell), l = 0 (s), mₗ = 0, mₛ = +½ (NEB 2024, 3 marks). Validity check: n = 3, l = 1, mₗ = +2 fails because mₗ = +2 exceeds l = 1 (NEB 2023, 2 marks).

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Bohr cannot split lines in magnetic fields (Zeeman), handle multi-electron repulsion, or explain fine structure — the quantum model replaces it, keeping only quantised energy. Heisenberg is fundamental indeterminacy, not instrument clumsiness. de Broglie waves show measurably only for tiny masses (electrons, not cricket balls).

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Bohr: centripetal mv²/r = kZe²/r² plus mvr = nh/2π → eliminate v → rₙ = n²h²/(4π²mkZe²), Eₙ = −2π²mk²Z²e⁴/(n²h²) = −13.6Z²/n² eV. Differences ΔE = E₂−E₁ = hν generate the Lyman/Balmer/Paschen series — each line a quantum jump made visible.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Quantum-number validity: check l < n first, then |mₗ| ≤ l — two inequalities kill most MCQ options. Filling order chant: 1s 2s 2p 3s 3p 4s 3d. Aufbau example: always show the diagonal/Box diagram for full marks (NEB 2023 asked exactly this).

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): four quantum numbers of Na's valence electron. NEB 2023 (3): Aufbau principle with example. NEB 2023 (2): which given quantum-number sets are valid. Bohr postulates + hydrogen spectrum rotate yearly.
